candidates.title: Impact wave: emit cached source-projected Z
candidates.notes:
Repairs the observed painter-depth seam without changing XY, UV, topology, colour,
source command order, alpha policy, or existing near-plane rejection. Requires
natural-path occlusion and performance proof. Does NOT solve the separate full-
alpha depth-write or clipping questions. Review R02 independently.

candidates.title: Effect-model submissions: inherit source Z-buffer state
candidates.notes:
Restore the source default only for effect-model submissions. Individual generated
geometry clear/set masks remain authoritative. Do not apply to link-14 weapons or
stage sky/foreground layers. All affected effect callbacks must be audited; this
patch is not a blanket claim that every reported effect should use real depth.

candidates.title: CSS: retire native image bindings before every load reset
candidates.status: DEFENSIVE CANDIDATE / not a complete CSS fix
candidates.notes:
Brings the acquire/reset and failed-begin paths into the same lifetime order as
existing retire/cancel paths. It does not eliminate blocking I/O, enable the
roster, repair an invisible preview, or prove the reported symptoms disappear.
Keep the existing one-action budget and shared 0x152 collision repair intact.

candidates.title: Link SpecialN: preserve foreign-table routing when Kirby images are disabled
candidates.notes:
The Kirby-enabled branch already routes Link SpecialN source-owner 2 to the
boomerang tables and light preambles. The alternative branch does not. Mirror
that existing routing, including detail selection and refusal of invalid owners.
This fixes an independently observable configuration defect; attribution to the
owner's reported ROM still requires its build configuration and natural frames.
No root program, fighter visibility bit, or source move is changed.

candidates.title: DATA: source-art surfaces for locked and unlocked layouts
candidates.status: IMPLEMENTATION CANDIDATE / producer + runtime; asset regeneration required
candidates.notes:
Replaces the retired text-slab consumer with the same native surface API as
Options. Adds source DATA background and ten row-state surfaces at the END of
the generated surface list, preserving prior IDs. Keeps unlock policy and scene
routing unchanged. Assets/O2R are unavailable here: regenerate on the prepared
checkout and verify dependency/staging, bounds, memory, natural pixels and
cadence. DATA children (VS Record/Sound Test) remain separate unclosed work.

# Native DATA: source mn/mndata/mndata.c; append after existing surfaces.
# The source uses a 16*8 middle strip, not Options' 17*8 strip. Two-row and
# three-row layouts have different positions; unlocking changes layout only.
DATA_BACKGROUND = (
    COLLAGE_FULL_BLEED,
    Placement("MNCommon", "llMNCommonDecalPaperSprite", 140, 143, False,
              (0xA0, 0x78, 0x14)),
    Placement("MNCommon", "llMNCommonDecalPaperSprite", 225, 56, False,
              (0xA0, 0x78, 0x14)),
    Placement("MNData", "llMNDataDataIconDarkSprite", 10, 10, False,
              (0x99, 0x99, 0x99)),
    Placement("MNData", "", 225, 143, False,
              fill=(0xA0, 0x78, 0x14, 0xE6), size=(85, 87)),
    Placement("MNCommon", "llMNCommonSmashLogoSprite", 235, 158, False,
              (0x00, 0x00, 0x00)),
    Placement("MNData", "llMNDataDataTextSprite", 206, 131, False,
              (0x00, 0x00, 0x00)),
)


def data_row_surface(layout: str, row: str, x: int, y: int,
                     text_dx: int, hi: bool) -> SurfaceSpec:
    """Source tab and label, including background under the dirty rectangle."""
    env, prim = OPTION_TAB_HI if hi else OPTION_TAB_NOT
    symbol = {
        "CHARACTERS": "llMNDataCharactersTextSprite",
        "VS_RECORD": "llMNDataVSRecordTextSprite",
        "SOUND_TEST": "llMNDataSoundTestTextSprite",
    }[row]
    parts = (
        Placement("MNCommon", "llMNCommonOptionTabLeftSprite", x, y,
                  False, prim, env=env),
        Placement("MNCommon", "llMNCommonOptionTabMiddleSprite", x + 16, y,
                  False, prim, env=env, tile=(16 * 8, 29), period=(16, None)),
        Placement("MNCommon", "llMNCommonOptionTabRightSprite", x + 144, y,
                  False, prim, env=env),
        Placement("MNData", symbol, x + text_dx, y + 4, False,
                  (0x00, 0x00, 0x00)),
    )
    token = f"DATA_{layout}_{row}" + ("_HI" if hi else "")
    # Options reserves 172 columns for a 17*8 middle. DATA's 16*8 middle
    # requires eight fewer. Includes the same right cap without truncation.
    return SurfaceSpec(token, parts, MENU_FIELD, under=DATA_BACKGROUND,
                       box=(x, y, 164, 29))


DATA_SURFACE_SPECS = (
    SurfaceSpec("DATA", DATA_BACKGROUND, MENU_FIELD),
    *(data_row_surface(layout, row, x, y, dx, hi)
      for layout, rows in (
          ("LOCKED", (("CHARACTERS", 113, 57, 26),
                      ("VS_RECORD", 81, 126, 27))),
          ("UNLOCKED", (("CHARACTERS", 133, 42, 26),
                        ("VS_RECORD", 101, 89, 27),
                        ("SOUND_TEST", 69, 136, 26))),
      )
      for row, x, y, dx in rows
      for hi in (False, True)),
)


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
